catalog.title: Cell deconvolution (HiTIMED)
catalog.summary: HiTIMED hierarchy cell deconvolution specialty pack.

_notes.hierarchy: hitimed method selects its tree from the project regulatory primary_analyte (buffy_coat | cfdna | tissue) via the packaged hierarchy basis analyte_trees map.
_notes.cfdna: For primary_analyte=cfdna, add 'tumor_fraction' to covariate_composition_columns and point actionConfig.cell_deconvolution.hierarchy_basis_path at the cfDNA plasma-atlas basis (cfdna_plasma_atlas_v1.json). tumor_fraction is the lumped ctDNA burden covariate; keep a stable non-tumor leaf (e.g. Neu) as the ALR reference.
_notes.composition: Leaves are a composition (sum to 1); ALR is required so the second-stage stacker treats them as compositional covariates.
